title: TailoringOutput v1
description: Canonical output shape for T3b job tailoring (FR-601/602, ADR-0011). Runtime validation is hand-written in src/ai/validation.ts; this file is the versioned contract the prompt points at.

matchedKeywords.description: JD keywords also present in the resume excerpt. Each must substring-match both inputs.

unsupportedKeywords.description: JD keywords absent from the resume excerpt. Never presented as user skills.

sectionsToStrengthen.description: Sections relevant to the JD that carry little or no matched keywords.

clarifyingQuestions.description: Questions that assert no facts — no numbers or entities absent from both inputs.

warnings.description: Truncation notes or unused-input notes, or empty.
